summary: Aptera Motors Corp. filed an 8-K disclosing a Warrant Inducement Agreement with holders to cash-exercise existing warrants to purchase up to 2,880,000 shares at a reduced price of $2.07 per share, raising about $5.96 million. In consideration, the company will issue new Inducement Warrants to purchase up to 4,320,000 shares at $2.25 per share, exercisable from January 13, 2027 through January 13, 2032. A.G.P. serves as financial advisor. This is a standard equity-linked financing, not a special situation requiring its own category; the filing does not represent a change of control, restructuring, or similar transformative event.
